title: Lekalo generate --check drift receipt
description: Closed contract of the `lekalo generate --check` receipt (issue #34 provider boundary, fix round 1; the workflow `drift` operation). The command embeds no `schemaVersion` member in its payload; this describing schema is the exact output negotiation target advertised as `lekalo/generate-check/v0.6.3` by the workflow-provider manifest. A clean or findings-only check is exit 0 stdout; any blocking drift finding (stale, manual-drift, missing, orphan) fails the run `invalid` (exit 1, stderr) with the typed diagnostic (`lock.stale`, `lock.source-changed`, `structure.document-missing`, `structure.runtime-unexpected-entry`) — those failures are outside this success receipt. This is a read-only drift check: it never applies generation and never needs an adapter program.

status.description: Always valid on this success stream.

manifestDigest.description: The verified ownership-manifest digest; null for the vacuous no-manifest check. Always emitted.

lockDigest.description: The exact lock digest the check bound to; the consumer's revision-binding anchor for this observation.

verdict.description: clean when nothing was reported; reported when only non-blocking findings exist.

findings.description: The sorted non-blocking findings; empty exactly when verdict is clean. The wire bound is the ownership manifest's artifact-entry bound (65536, artifacts/canonical.rs): at most one finding per entry, and orphan findings always block instead of appearing here.

finding.description: One non-blocking finding. Every success-receipt finding comes from a manifest entry (orphan findings always block, exit 1), so the entry identity is always emitted: owner, kind, and lifecycle are present on every finding.

path.description: The project-relative logical path of the artifact. The wire grammar (ArtifactPath) bounds each segment (≤64, portable lowercase, no dot-trailing or parent segments) with no total-length bound, so no maxLength applies here.

owner.description: The semantic owner of the manifest entry; the Model 0.2.16 symbol-id grammar (two or three `[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}` segments, total 3-191).

kind.description: The closed artifact kind of the manifest entry.

lifecycle.description: The artifact lifecycle of the manifest entry. Generated-lifecycle findings always block (exit 1) and never appear here, so a receipt finding carries exactly one of the non-generated lifecycles.

verdict.description: The closed non-blocking finding verdict: stale, manual drift, or missing. Orphans always block (exit 1) and clean entries are only counted, so neither ever appears as a finding verdict.
